The latest Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) Recruitment 2026 has been announced for Entry Level Profiles (Junior Executive, Associate Executive & Secretary) posts! Published on the official website https://www.bharatpetroleum.in, this new recruitment drive offers 250 openings for eligible candidates. Applicants within the 32 to 35 years age group and possessing qualifications like Diploma, Graduation, M.Sc, Masters in Hindi, or Inter CA/CMA can apply online from 18 April 2026 to 24 May 2026. Find all details about the BPCL Entry Level Profiles new vacancy 2026, including eligibility, online form, and notification PDF

BPCL Entry Level Profiles Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates must fulfil the essential educational qualification and minimum work-experience as on 01.04.2026.

Junior Executive (Engineering):

  • Educational Qualification: Diploma in Engineering (3-year course) in Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation / Electronics / Civil / Chemical Engineering from a recognized University with minimum 55% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Work Experience: Minimum 5 years of continuous post-qualification relevant work experience (including minimum 1 year in managerial/supervisory role) in sectors like POL Terminal/Depot, LPG Bottling Plant, Pipeline, Refinery, Petrochemical, etc.

Junior Executive (Accounts)

  • Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline with minimum 55% + Inter CA / Inter CMA.
  • Work Experience: Minimum 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience in finance function.

Junior Executive (Wayside Amenities)

  • Educational Qualification: B.Com / BBA / B.Sc / BMS / BHM with minimum 55% (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Work Experience:  Minimum 5 years of relevant post-qualification experience (at least 3 years in Facility Management / QSR / Retail / Hospitality, etc.).

Secretary

  • Educational Qualification: Class X + Class XII + Bachelor's Degree (3-year course) with minimum 55% in each (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Work Experience: Minimum 5 years as Secretarial Assistant / Secretary or similar roles.

Associate Executive (Quality Assurance)

  • Educational Qualification: M.Sc (Chemistry) with specialization in specified branches with minimum 60% (relaxed to 55% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Work Experience: Minimum 3 years post-qualification relevant work experience in laboratory in Petroleum / Oil & Gas / Petro-Chemical / Chemical industry.

Associate Executive (Official Language Implementation)

 

  • Educational Qualification: Master’s in Hindi (2-year course) with minimum 55% (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD) + English studied in Class XII / Graduation with minimum 55%.
  • Work Experience: Minimum 3 years of post-qualification work experience in translation (English ↔ Hindi).

Common Note for All Profiles

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible.

BPCL Entry Level Profiles Selection Process 2026

  • Multi-stage selection process may comprise Application Screening, Written / Computer Based Test, Case Based Discussion, Group Task, Personal Interview etc.
  • Provisional selection based on Relevant work-experience, Significant on-the-job achievements, Performance in various selection processes.
  • Final appointment subject to successful completion of Pre-Employment Medical Examination.

How to Apply for BPCL Recruitment 2026

Candidates must apply ONLINE only through the official BPCL website. No other mode of application will be accepted. The online application process is open from 18 April 2026 to 24 May 2026 (23:59 hrs).

Step-by-Step Application Process

  1. Check Eligibility: Ensure that you meet all the eligibility criteria including educational qualification, age limit, and work experience before applying. No eligibility-related queries will be entertained.
  2. Keep Documents Ready: Prepare scanned copies (PDF format) of the following documents:
    • Date of Birth Proof (Class 10th/12th Certificate)
    • Educational Qualification Certificates (Marksheet + Degree/Diploma)
    • Work Experience Certificates (with job role, duration, salary, etc.)
    • Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable)
    • Recent Passport Size Photograph (latest, not older than April 2026)
    • Scanned Signature (not in CAPITAL letters)
    • Last 3 Salary Slips (combined in one PDF)
  3. Register Online:
    • Visit the BPCL Careers page and click on “Apply Online”
    • Click on “New Registration”
    • Enter Name, Email ID, and Mobile Number
    • Note the Registration Number and Password generated
  4. Fill Application Form:
    • Login using credentials
    • Fill personal, educational, and experience details carefully
    • Use “Save & Next” to verify details
  5. Upload Documents: Upload photograph, signature, and required documents as per prescribed format.
  6. Preview Application: Carefully review all details using the Preview Tab before final submission. No changes will be allowed after submission.
  7. Pay Application Fee:
    • Pay via Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI / Net Banking
    • Ensure payment status shows “Completed”
    • Take a printout of payment receipt
  8. Final Submission: Click on “Submit” to complete the application process.

Important Instructions

  • Apply only once; multiple applications may lead to rejection.
  • No hard copy of application needs to be sent to BPCL.
  • Ensure all details match original documents; mismatch may lead to disqualification.
  • Keep your registered email ID and mobile number active for future communication.

BPCL Entry Level Profiles Online Application Form

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the BPCL Entry Level Profiles can do so by submitting their application form online through the official BPCL website. The application process for the BPCL Recruitment 2026 is completely online, and candidates must ensure that they complete all steps before the deadline.

The online application process for the BPCL Entry Level Profiles Recruitment 2026 is available through the BPCL portal. Eligible candidates are encouraged to fill out the application form and submit the required documents before the last date.

Click Here to Apply Online for BPCL Entry Level Profiles Recruitment 2026

Candidates will be inducted at the minimum of the pay scale. In addition to Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance (IDA pattern), HRA (if applicable), Perks & Allowances, Retirement Benefits and Performance Related Pay will be payable as per Corporation’s policy.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • The cutoff date for age, qualification, and experience is 01 April 2026.
  • All qualifications must be from AICTE/UGC recognized institutions.
  • Marks should be calculated on total aggregate; no rounding off allowed.
  • CGPA must be converted into percentage as per university norms.
  • Only post-qualification experience will be considered.
  • Internship/training during studies will not be counted.
  • Candidates must fill the application form carefully; details once submitted are final.
  • No changes will be allowed after final submission.
  • Submit only one application; latest application will be considered if multiple are submitted.
  • Candidates working in Govt/PSU must produce NOC during selection.
  • Shortlisting is provisional and subject to document verification.
  • Ineligible candidates at any stage will be disqualified.
  • All communication will be done via registered email only.
  • Selection process participation does not guarantee final selection.
  • Updates/corrigendum will be available only on the official website.
  • Travel Allowance (TA) will be provided as per rules for eligible candidates.
  • BPCL reserves the right to cancel/modify recruitment or change vacancies.
  • Providing false information will lead to disqualification.
  • Canvassing or external influence will result in rejection.
  • Apply only through the official portal; beware of fraudulent agents.
  • Any dispute will be subject to Mumbai jurisdiction.

The Reserve Bank of India Services Board has officially released Advertisement No. RBISB/DA/01/2026-27 for recruitment to 60 posts of Officers in Grade 'B' (Direct Recruit-DR) (On Probation-OP) under the General, DEPR, and DSIM Cadres – Panel Year 2026. RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on April 01, 2026. Nationality conditions apply – the post is open to citizens of India and certain other categories as specified in the notification, subject to eligibility certificate from the Government of India where required.

The educational qualification must be from a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature, or an institution declared Deemed University under UGC Act, 1956, or an equivalent foreign university recognized by the Association of Indian Universities.

Educational Qualification

Post Minimum Educational Qualifications (as on April 01, 2026)
Officers in Grade 'B' (DR) – General Graduation in any discipline with minimum 60% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwBD if posts reserved for them) OR Post-Graduation with minimum 55% marks (pass marks for SC/ST/PwBD if posts reserved for them) in aggregate of all semesters/years.
Officers in Grade 'B' (DR) – DEPR Essential: MA/MSc in Economics or related Economics/Finance disciplines with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwBD if posts reserved) from a recognized Indian or Foreign University. Desirable: Doctorate in Economics, or research/teaching experience, or publication in standard journals.
Officers in Grade 'B' (DR) – DSIM Essential: Master's Degree with minimum 55% marks in Statistics/Mathematics/Data Science/AI/ML or related fields OR Four-year Bachelor's Degree with minimum 60% marks in the above fields (50% for SC/ST/PwBD if posts reserved). Desirable: Doctorate in related subjects; research/teaching experience and publications.

RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must have attained the age of 21 years and must not have attained the age of 30 years as on April 01, 2026 (born not earlier than April 02, 1996 and not later than April 01, 2005). The upper age limit is relaxed for various categories as detailed below.

General/EWS candidates who have already appeared six times for Phase-I Examination for this post in the past are not eligible to apply. No such restriction applies to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates if posts are reserved for them.

RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying for the post of Officers in Grade 'B' are required to pay a non-refundable fee/intimation charges as specified below. The fee must be paid online through the RBI application portal. Fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances nor held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

Candidates submitting applications without the prescribed fee/intimation charges will be summarily rejected. Candidates are therefore advised to confirm their eligibility and verify all details before making payment.

Bank/Transaction charges are to be borne by the candidate.

RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for RBI Grade B Recruitment 2026 consists of Phase-I Online Examination, Phase-II Online/Written Examination, and Interview. Candidates who qualify Phase-I will be shortlisted for Phase-II based on aggregate marks. Only those who clear Phase-II will be called for the Interview.

No candidate will be called for the Interview unless he/she appears in Phase-II examination. The final merit list will be prepared by adding marks secured in Phase-II and Interview (and grace marks as applicable). If a candidate remains absent in the Interview, his/her candidature will not be considered for final selection.

The selection list recommended by the Board remains valid for the period as decided by the Board/Bank.

RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Exam Syllabus

Phase-I – General Cadre (200 Marks, Objective MCQ, 120 Minutes)

The paper covers General Awareness, English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, and Reasoning. Separate time will be allotted for each section. Detailed information will be provided in the Information Handout available with the Admit Card.

Phase-II – General Cadre

Paper-I (Economic and Social Issues): Growth and Development (National Income, poverty alleviation, sustainable development); Indian Economy (economic history, monetary and fiscal policy since 1991, Indian money and financial markets, public finance, agriculture, services sector); Globalization (BoP, export-import policy, IMF, World Bank, WTO); Social Structure in India (multiculturalism, demographic trends, urbanization, gender issues, social justice).

Paper-II (English – Writing Skills): Writing skills including expression and understanding of the topic.

Paper-III (General Finance and Management): Financial system (structure of financial institutions, RBI functions, banking system, digital payments); Financial markets (primary and secondary markets); General topics (financial risk management, derivatives, financial inclusion, corporate governance, Union Budget, accounting basics, inflation); Management (fundamentals, organizational behaviour, motivation, leadership, ethics, corporate governance, communication).

Phase-I – DEPR Cadre (Paper-I, Objective – Economics)

Microeconomics, Macroeconomics (IS-LM Model, schools of economic thought), International Economics, Theories of Economic Growth and Development, Public Finance, Environmental Economics, Quantitative Methods in Economics, Current developments in Indian Economy.

Phase-II – DEPR Cadre (Descriptive – Economics)

Paper-I covers Microeconomics Module (consumer theory, production theory, market theory, welfare economics) and Macroeconomics Module (national income accounting, employment and output, inflation, money and banking, growth theories, international trade, public finance) with equal weightage. Paper-II covers Quantitative Methods in Economics (mathematical methods, statistical methods, econometrics) and Indian Economy – Policy and Trends (fiscal policy, monetary policy, banking sector, inflation, external sector, sectoral developments) with equal weightage.

Phase-I – DSIM Cadre (Paper-I, Objective – Statistics) and Phase-II (Paper-II, Descriptive – Statistics)

Topics covered across both papers: Theory of Probability, Probability Distributions and Sampling Theory; Linear Models and Economic Statistics; Statistical Inference (Estimation, Testing of Hypothesis, Non-Parametric Tests); Stochastic Processes; Multivariate Analysis; Econometrics and Time Series; Optimization and Statistical Computing; Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Techniques; Database and Data Warehouse Management.

How to Apply for RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the Bank's website www.rbi.org.in. No other means/mode of application will be accepted. The online portal will be active from 29-04-2026 to 20-05-2026 (6:00 PM). Candidates desirous of applying for both Grade 'B' (DR)-General and Grade 'B' (DR)-DEPR or DSIM must apply using separate links and pay fees for both. Digi Locker has been integrated with the online application form for voluntary submission of credentials.

Candidates should avoid submitting multiple applications; if done unavoidably, only the application with the higher Registration ID (RID) will be considered valid, and fee paid against other RIDs will not be adjusted. After the closing date, a 2-day edit window will be available for making corrections in limited fields. Candidates are not required to upload supporting documents at the time of online application; documents will be verified at the Interview stage only.

Documents Required at Interview Stage:

  • Age proof (birth certificate or Class X marksheet/certificate)
  • Educational qualification certificates and marksheets
  • SC / ST / OBC / PwBD / EWS / Ex-SM certificate (if applicable) in prescribed format
  • Photo identity proof (PAN Card / Passport / Driving Licence / Voter's Card / Aadhaar, etc.)
  • Online application form printout with fee payment receipt

Candidates working in Government/PSU/Public Enterprises must inform their employer in writing before applying and submit an undertaking to this effect at the time of online application. At the time of joining, proper discharge certificates from their employer must be produced.

Apply Online at: https://www.rbi.org.in

Important Instructions for RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only eligible citizens (as defined in the notification) are eligible to apply; nationality certificate required for certain categories.
  • Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on April 01, 2026.
  • No hard copy applications will be accepted – online submission only.
  • Recruitment fee/intimation charges are non-refundable; applications without prescribed fee will be summarily rejected.
  • Government/PSU employees must submit an undertaking about informing their employer and bring discharge certificate at the time of joining.
  • Mobile phones, pagers, and all electronic devices are banned inside examination/interview premises; physical calculators are not permitted in any phase.
  • Candidates reporting after Gate Closure Time specified on the Admit Card will not be permitted to take the examination.
  • Candidates are advised to visit https://www.rbi.org.in regularly for updates; all corrigenda will be published on the Bank's website only.
  • Phase-I paper (General Cadre) will be set in English; all other papers (except English papers) will be set bilingually in Hindi and English.
  • Negative marking on MCQ questions will apply as prescribed; detailed marking scheme will be in the Information Handout.
  • For any problem in filling the form or downloading Admit Card, queries may be raised through http://cgrs.ibps.in mentioning the post and cadre in the subject line.
  • All decisions of the Board regarding eligibility, conduct of examinations, selection, and other matters are final and binding; any resultant dispute is subject to sole jurisdiction of Courts at Mumbai.

Union Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the cut-off date 01-04-2026. Candidates should NOT have undergone Apprenticeship either with Union Bank of India or in any other organization earlier, or be currently pursuing Apprenticeship Training as per the Apprentices Act 1961 as amended. Candidates who had completed apprenticeship training or had job experience for one year or more after completing the educational qualification are also not eligible.

The candidate applying for trainee seats of a particular state should be proficient (reading, writing, speaking and understanding) in any one of the local languages of that state. Candidates must possess the prescribed minimum qualification on the cut-off date; admission to all stages is provisional and subject to eligibility verification.

Educational Qualification

Qualification Details
Graduate Degree Graduate degree in any discipline from any Institute / College / University recognized / approved by Govt. bodies / AICTE / UGC. The result must have been declared on or before 01.04.2026. The date of passing Graduation should not be more than 4 years preceding the cut-off date (i.e. Graduation Marksheet should not be prior to 01.04.2022).
Nationality / Citizenship Must be a Citizen of India or subject of Nepal / Bhutan / eligible person of Indian origin as per prescribed criteria. A certificate of eligibility from Govt. of India is required for non-Indian citizens in eligible categories.
Local Language Proficiency Candidate must be proficient in any one of the local languages of the applied state (reading, writing, speaking and understanding). Evidence via 10th/12th marksheet/certificate or local language proficiency test.

Union Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for Union Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 consists of 2 (two) stages - an Online Test of 100 marks (objective type, 60 minutes) and a Proficiency Test of Local Language. Candidates who qualify the online test with cut-off marks as decided by the Bank will be called for document verification and the local language proficiency test. How to Apply for Union Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the BFSI SSC portal. Hard copy of application and other documents must not be sent to the Bank's office. Candidates are requested to apply online through https://unionbankofindia.bank.in/recruitment.aspx or https://beep.bfsissc.com/candidate_register/mkt. All candidates must also register on the NAPS portal (https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/) and NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php) before applying and note their Apprentice Registration Code (NAPS) and Enrolment ID (NATS) for future correspondence.

Candidates should avoid submitting multiple applications; if done unavoidably, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained, and fee paid against other applications will stand forfeited. No change of data is allowed after final submission of the online application.

Important Instructions for Union Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • The engagement of apprentices is not an employment in the Bank; it is on-job training to gain experience. The Bank has no obligation to offer regular employment on completion of the program.
  • Candidates should NOT have undergone or be currently pursuing Apprenticeship in any organization under the Apprentices Act 1961 as amended.
  • Candidates who had job experience of one year or more after completing educational qualification are NOT eligible.
  • No hard copy of application or other documents to be sent to the Bank's office – online submission only.
  • Examination fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other exam or selection.
  • Not more than one application to be submitted; in case of multiple applications only the last valid application will be retained.
  • All candidates must produce Aadhaar number before engagement (contract signing).
  • The online examination will be conducted using candidate's own camera-enabled device (desktop / laptop / tablet / smartphone).
  • Candidates are NOT permitted to use calculators during the examination.
  • Government employees must produce NOC at the time of interview if application not routed through Proper Channel.
  • Candidates are advised to visit www.unionbankofindia.bank.in regularly for updates on this recruitment.
  • The Apprentices are prohibited from joining / forming any Union Body.
  • All decisions of the Bank regarding eligibility, selection, and other matters are final and binding. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Pay & Other Benefits

In addition to the consolidated monthly pay mentioned against each post, MECON offers a comprehensive benefits package to all contractual employees. Employees deployed at site/project locations receive a Site Allowance of 7.5% of pay, while those at Metro locations receive a Metro Allowance of 2.5% of pay. An annual increment on consolidated pay (rounded to the next ten rupees) is provided subject to company rules. Medical facilities including OPD and IPD treatment are available at Ispat Hospital, Ranchi, for employees posted at Ranchi (covering self, spouse, and 2 dependent children). For other locations, a company-retained doctor provides free consultation. Additionally, reimbursement of up to ₹15,000 per year towards Mediclaim premium (₹4,00,000 on floater basis) is available as per company policy.

Company accommodation (family or bachelor) may be provided based on availability at applicable charges; if not availed, HRA at 5% of consolidated pay is payable. Leave entitlements include Casual Leave (12 days/year), Earned Leave (18 days/year, accumulation up to 45 days), Half Pay Leave (14 days/year with commutation on medical certificate), and Maternity Leave as applicable to regular employees. National, Festival, and Restricted Holidays (4 nos.) are as per regular employee norms. All employees are covered under a Group Personal Accident Policy with a Sum Insured of ₹25 Lakhs.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Definition of Work Experience

Work experience will be counted only if it is in a full-time job on a regular salary basis and in the relevant area as stipulated against the respective post. Intermittent or freelance experience will not be counted. Entrepreneurial experience is also not eligible. For Management Trainees, Executive Trainees, and Graduate Trainees, only the on-the-job training period served in PSUs will be counted towards experience. Articleship, internship, academic projects, teaching, and research experience will not be considered as post-qualification experience. However, the period of apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act will be counted towards the required post-qualification experience. All experience claimed must be substantiated with documentary evidence as specified; self-declarations regarding the nature of work or relevance of experience will not be accepted.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Documentary Evidence for Work Experience

Candidates must provide valid work experience certificates for all past employments mentioned in the application form. These certificates must clearly mention the date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and specific areas of experience with relevance to the applied post. In the absence of a certificate from any past employer, the experience from that employer will not be counted, and the candidature may be rejected if minimum experience is not met. For current employment, candidates must submit an Experience Certificate or Offer/Appointment Letter along with Pay Slips for the last 3 months from the date of the advertisement. Identity Card proving continuity of employment may also be submitted. Non-submission of these documents may result in rejection. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will lead to summary rejection.

Employment Type Required Documents
Past Employment Experience certificate(s) with date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and relevance to the applied post
Current Employment Experience Certificate OR Offer/Appointment Letter + Last 3 months Pay Slips + Identity Card (to prove continuity)

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit & Relaxation

The upper age limit for each post is 50 years for General (UR) and EWS category candidates, as calculated on the cut-off date of 23.03.2026. Age relaxation is provided as per Government of India guidelines. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates get a relaxation of 3 years, SC/ST candidates get 5 years, and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) get relaxation of 10 years (General), 13 years (OBC-NCL), or 15 years (SC/ST).

Category Age Relaxation
General (UR) / EWS Upper Age Limit as per post (50 years for all posts in this recruitment)
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years relaxation
SC / ST 5 years relaxation
PwD - General (UR) 10 years relaxation
PwD - OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 13 years relaxation
PwD - SC / ST 15 years relaxation
J&K Domicile (01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989) 5 years relaxation

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Reservations & Relaxations

Reservations for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), PwD (Persons with Disability - 40% or above), and EWS candidates are provided as per Government of India guidelines. Reservation for PwD is on a horizontal basis. SC, ST, and OBC (NCL) candidates applying against UR category posts will be considered on General category merit - no age relaxation or fee waiver applies to them in such cases. OBC (NCL) candidates must produce a valid certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India; the certificate must not be more than 1 year old as on the date of advertisement. EWS candidates must produce an Income and Asset Certificate issued by the competent authority (such as District Magistrate, Revenue Officer not below Tehsildar rank, etc.) in the prescribed format available on MECON's website. The crucial date for the Income and Asset Certificate is the closing date for online applications.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying under UR, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), or EWS category are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of ₹500 (Rupees Five Hundred only). Candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwD, or Ex-Servicemen categories, as well as internal MECON candidates, are fully exempted from paying any fee.

The application fee must be paid online through the payment gateway provided on MECON's official website. No other mode of payment (such as demand draft, postal order, or cash) is accepted. Once the fee is paid, candidates must click the "Verify" button to update the application status to "Submitted." Fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates are strongly advised to verify their eligibility before making payment. Applications submitted without fee or with insufficient fee will be rejected.

Category Application Fee
UR / OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) / EWS ₹500 (Non-Refundable)
SC / ST / PwD / Ex-Servicemen / Internal Candidates NIL (Exempted)

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Selection Mode

The selection process for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 is through Walk-In-Interview. Walk-In-Interviews will be conducted at four locations - Delhi, Ranchi, Kolkata, and Bangalore - and the specific dates and times will be published on the MECON Careers page. Candidates must apply online before appearing for the interview.

On the date of the Walk-In-Interview, document scrutiny will be undertaken; if any claim in the application is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview and no TA will be reimbursed. The final list of selected candidates will be published on MECON's website and communicated via registered email ID only. MECON reserves the right to change the mode of selection at its discretion.

Stage Details
Step 1 Submit Online Application on MECON website between 27.04.2026 and 11.05.2026
Step 2 Check MECON Careers page for Walk-In-Interview schedule (date, time & venue)
Step 3 Appear for Walk-In-Interview at Delhi / Ranchi / Kolkata / Bangalore with all original documents
Step 4 Document Scrutiny on day of Walk-In-Interview
Step 5 Personal Interview
Step 6 Medical Examination (before joining)
Final Result Published on MECON website and communicated via registered email

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Travelling Allowance (TA) for Interview

Outstation candidates who appear for the Walk-In-Interview are entitled to reimbursement of travelling allowance (TA) for to-and-fro travel by the shortest route from their mailing address (as mentioned in the application) to the interview venue. TA will be paid at III Tier AC (3A) / Chair Car (CC) rail fare rates, or ₹7 per km by road, whichever is less, subject to production of original tickets/receipts and/or boarding passes. Rail fare will be at regular (non-Tatkal/non-premium Tatkal) rates only. Internal MECON candidates will be governed by company service rules.

Candidates should note that scrutiny of applications is conducted on the interview date itself - if any claim is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. TA forms must be submitted along with proof of travel, bank account number, and IFSC code of the bank branch for payment processing.

Grade Travelling Allowance
Contract III Tier A/C (3A) / CC by rail OR ₹7 per km by road - whichever is less, subject to production of ticket/receipt and/or boarding pass. Regular rail fare only (No premium/Tatkal).

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Place of Posting

The initial place of posting for each post code is as listed in the table below. Post Codes 01 to 23 are for Rampura Agucha Mines / Debari, Rajasthan; Post Codes 24 to 25 for Bangalore, Karnataka; Post Codes 26 to 27 for Bacheli, Chhattisgarh; Post Code 28 for Ranchi, Jharkhand; Post Codes 29 to 35 for Malanjkhand, Madhya Pradesh; and Post Codes 36 to 60 for Burnpur, West Bengal. Candidates should note that the initial place of posting is indicative only - MECON reserves the right to post selected candidates at any project site, location, or office of the company based on organizational requirements. Candidates must be prepared for transfers/postings anywhere in India as per management discretion.

How to Apply for MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026

Applications for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online only through MECON's official website (www.meconlimited.co.in → Careers → Career Opportunities → Apply Online). No offline or postal applications will be accepted. Candidates must apply between 27 April 2026 and 11 May 2026. During the online application process, candidates must upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), a signature image in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), and self-attested PDF copies of all required documents.

If multiple documents need to be merged, they must be combined into a single PDF not exceeding 1 MB. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will result in summary rejection. No modifications are allowed after submission of the online application, so candidates must take utmost care before final submission.

Government/PSU employees must forward their application through Proper Channel or produce an NOC at the time of the interview; failure to do so means they will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. Hard copies of the online application and all required documents must be brought on the date of the Walk-In-Interview.

Documents to be uploaded online:

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
  • Signature in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
  • Matriculation/Secondary Board certificate or Municipal Birth Certificate (proof of age)
  • Final/Provisional Graduation and Post-Graduation certificates (as applicable)
  • All semester/year-wise mark sheets or consolidated mark sheet
  • Work experience certificates/documents as per Para 6 of the notification
  • PAN Card and Aadhaar Card
  • Caste certificate - OBC (NCL) / EWS / SC / ST (as applicable; OBC certificate not more than 1 year old)
  • PwD certificate in prescribed Govt. of India format (if applicable)
  • Income & Asset Certificate for EWS candidates as per DoPT OM No.36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31.01.2019
  • Discharge/Service Certificate (for Ex-Servicemen)
  • J&K Domicile Certificate (if applicable)
  • Meritorious Sportsperson Certificate (if applicable)

Important Instructions for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All documents must be self-attested; third-party attestation is not required unless specifically mentioned.
  • Original certificates/documents must be produced at the time of the Walk-In-Interview.
  • No modifications are allowed after submission of the online application.
  • Government/PSU employees must produce NOC from present employer at interview.
  • Certificates in languages other than Hindi/English must be accompanied by a certified translation.
  • Candidates must maintain a valid and active email ID and mobile number for at least 1 year - all future communications will be through email only.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Ranchi (Jharkhand) only.
  • MECON's decision in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding.

Essential Qualifications:

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Reservation Criteria

SC/ST/OBC: Caste certificate issued by competent authority must be uploaded. OBC candidates must submit a Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate issued between 01.04.2026 and 11.05.2026 (i.e., valid for financial year 2026-27) in the DoPT prescribed format. An additional declaration in Annexure-II must be submitted at document verification confirming non-creamy layer status.

EWS: Gross annual family income must be below ₹8 lakh for the financial year 2025-26. The family must not possess 5 acres or more of agricultural land, a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, or a residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more in notified municipalities. Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure-III format) must be issued between 01.04.2026 and 11.05.2026 by a competent authority (District Magistrate, Tehsildar, SDO, etc.). SC/ST/OBC candidates are not eligible for EWS reservation.

PwBD: Minimum 40% benchmark disability is required for fee exemption and age relaxation. Disability certificate from a government-authorized authority is mandatory. Scribe/Reader facility is available for eligible PwBD candidates (blindness, both-arm locomotor disability, cerebral palsy), subject to advance intimation via the online application. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of exam is allowed for scribe users.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process is conducted in two stages for a combined total of 100 marks:

Stage 1 - Computer Based Test (CBT): 75 Marks

  • Date: 22.05.2026
  • Duration: 50 minutes
  • Pattern: 50 objective-type questions × 1.5 marks each = 75 marks
  • Negative marking: 0.25 marks per wrong answer
  • Syllabus: Based on prescribed educational qualification and professional course content for each post/speciality
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS; 35% for SC/ST/OBC

Stage 2 - Departmental Interview & Assessment: 25 Marks

  • Date (Expected): 23.06.2026
  • Based on clinical evaluation, laboratory testing, structured viva, or personal interview as applicable
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS; 35% for SC/ST/OBC

Candidates are shortlisted after CBT in the ratio of 1:3 (three candidates per advertised post), category-wise and department-wise. Eligibility notice will be published on 16.06.2026. Only candidates appearing in the Eligibility Notice will be called for document verification and interview.

Final Merit: Aggregate of CBT (75 marks) + Departmental Interview (25 marks) for candidates who qualify both stages separately.

Tie-Breaking (in order):

  1. Fewer wrong answers / less negative marking in CBT
  2. Date of birth (older candidate ranked higher)
  3. Higher aggregate percentage in 10+2
  4. Higher aggregate percentage in Matric/10th standard

Examination Centres: Chandigarh (Tricity), Delhi/NCR, Hyderabad, Kolkata. City preference is on a first-come-first-served basis and once allotted, cannot be changed.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website: www.pgimer.edu.in and click on the Recruitment link on the Home Page.
  2. Register with mandatory details — name (as per matriculation), date of birth, mobile number, and email ID. Registration details cannot be changed once submitted.
  3. Log in using the User ID and password sent to your registered email and mobile number.
  4. Fill the Online Application Form section-by-section carefully. All entries are final on submission.
  5. Upload mandatory documents — educational certificates (from Matric onwards with mark sheets), MCI/DCI registration certificate, category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), NOC from present employer (if applicable), and passport-size photograph.
  6. Pay the application fee online via Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking.
  7. Take a printout of the final application form and e-Challan for future reference.

Photograph Instructions:

  • Clear passport-size colour photograph with light background in JPEG format, size 50-80 KB.
  • Must be taken on or after 01.03.2026.
  • Candidate's name and date of photograph must be written clearly on the photo.
  • No cap or goggles; spectacles are permitted.
  • Photo must be unattested on the application form.

Important: A candidate can apply for one department only. Applying for more than one department will result in rejection of all applications. No change in category or department is permitted after submission. Duplicate applications will be summarily rejected.

All posts are exclusively for Ex-Servicemen from the Indian Air Force (IAF).

Post Name Grade Total Posts

BEL Sr. Asst. Engineer (ESM) Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

This recruitment is exclusively for Ex-Servicemen from the Indian Air Force (IAF). Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on 01.04.2026. The minimum educational qualification is a 3-year Diploma in Electronics Engineering or equivalent. Candidates must have served in the IAF in the rank of Junior Warrant Officer (JWO) or above, with a minimum of 15 years of post-qualification experience.

The date of retirement from the IAF must be on or before 01.04.2026. The reservation is 100% for Ex-Servicemen. Candidates currently employed in the Armed Forces who are yet to be discharged must submit documentary proof of their medical category, character, and probable date of discharge.

BEL Sr. Asst. Engineer (ESM) Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

The upper age limit is calculated as on 01.04.2026. The maximum age for General (UR) and EWS candidates is 50 years. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates get a relaxation of 3 years (upper age limit: 53 years). SC/ST candidates get a relaxation of 5 years (upper age limit: 55 years).

PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability) candidates are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India rules applicable to their respective category. Since this recruitment is exclusively for Ex-Servicemen, age relaxation as per ESM/IAF service norms is inherently covered. Selected candidates will be inducted in the E-I Grade pay scale of Rs. 30,000/- – 3% – 1,20,000/-. The total tenure of engagement will be for a period of 15 years or until the date of superannuation (60 years of age), whichever is earlier. The engagement will be reviewed after every 5 years based on individual performance and project requirements. Posting will be on PAN-India Project Site locations as per company requirements.

Selection for the post of Senior Assistant Engineer, E-I Grade (Fixed Tenure) will be conducted through a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview. Only candidates who qualify in the written test will be called for the interview in a ratio of 1:7 (as per the vacancy in each category).

The candidature at all stages of the selection process is provisional in nature - merely fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience requirements does not guarantee being called for the written test. If the number of eligible applicants is high, the number of candidates to be called for the written test may be restricted based on academic excellence and experience.

BEL reserves the right to change, cancel, modify, or add to any criteria, method of selection, or number of posts based on actual requirements at the time of selection. All further announcements related to the written test date, venue, and result will be published on www.bel-india.in.

  • Find the recruitment notification: Click on the "Recruitment" or "Anganwadi Recruitment 2026" section.
  • Download and read the notification: Download and read the official notification PDF carefully before applying.
  • Register / Login: Create a new account using your mobile number and Aadhaar. If already registered, log in with your credentials.
  • Fill the application form: Enter personal details, educational qualification, address, and select your preferred district/ward. Ensure you apply only for a ward where you are a permanent resident.
  • Upload documents: Upload scanned copies of your passport-size photograph, signature, 10th/12th marksheet, Aadhaar card, and any caste/domicile certificate if required.
  • Review and submit: Check all entries carefully before final submission. Download and print the application confirmation / acknowledgement slip for your records.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs

Eligibility for forest department jobs depends on the post, state and recruitment authority. Below is a general idea of qualification and age for popular posts like Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer. Candidates should always check the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria.

Education Qualification for Forest Guard, Forester, Ranger

  • Forest Guard / Field Guard / Forest Watcher / Beat Guard: Usually 10th pass or 12th pass from a recognized board, knowledge of local language, and basic physical standards as per state rules.
  • Forester / Section Forest Officer / Deputy Forest Ranger: Generally 12th pass or graduate in any stream or science-related subjects, with physical standards and sometimes driving or technical skills depending on the post.
  • Forest Range Officer (RFO) / Forest Ranger / ACF: Normally graduate degree in Science, Agriculture, Forestry, Environmental Science, Engineering or related disciplines, with higher physical standards and sometimes a competitive exam similar to state PCS level.
  • IFS / Indian Forest Service and senior posts (DCF, CF, CCF, PCCF): Filled through UPSC Indian Forest Service Examination and promotions, requiring a graduate degree and all-India competitive selection.

Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Forest Guard / Forester / Field Guard: Minimum age is usually 18 years and maximum age is around 27–30 years, with age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, Ex-servicemen and other categories as per government rules.
  • Forest Range Officer / ACF and higher competitive posts: Age limit often ranges from 21 to 32 years (varies by recruitment), with relaxations for reserved categories.
  • Exact age limit, cut-off date and relaxation details always depend on the particular notification, so candidates should verify from the official advertisement before applying.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern

The selection process for Forest Department Jobs 2026 typically includes written examinations, physical tests and document verification. Some posts also conduct medical examination and walking tests due to the demanding nature of field duties.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  • Written Exam: Most Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer recruitments start with a written exam based on objective-type questions (MCQs).
  • PET / PST (Physical Efficiency Test / Physical Standard Test): Candidates who qualify written exam are called for running, walking test, height, chest measurement and other physical parameters as per post and gender.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates of age, qualification, caste, residence, sports/NCC and other documents mentioned in the notification.
  • Medical Examination: Many forest posts require medical fitness to ensure candidates can perform field duties in forests, wildlife areas and difficult terrain.

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

Typical syllabus for written exam may include:

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs (national, state-level, environment and forest-related topics)
  • General Hindi / English or regional language (grammar, comprehension, vocabulary)
  • General Mathematics / Quantitative Aptitude (up to 10th or 12th level)
  • General Science and Environmental Studies (forest, wildlife, biodiversity, conservation, climate, basic biology)
  • Reasoning Ability (logical and analytical reasoning)

Exact subject-wise marks, number of questions, negative marking and exam duration will be given in the respective forest department notification.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Fee

The application fee for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is ₹100 for General (UR), OBC, and EWS male candidates. Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen eligible for reservation are fully exempted from payment of fee.

Fee can be paid online only through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, or RuPay Debit Card. The fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be adjusted against any other examination. Candidates must ensure their fee payment is complete - if the fee is not received by SSC, the application status will show as "Incomplete" and will be summarily rejected.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Scheme of Examination

The SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 will consist of two papers. Paper-I is a Computer Based Examination with objective-type multiple choice questions, divided into two sections - General Hindi and General English - each carrying 100 marks with a sectional timer of 1 hour. There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I.

Based on performance in Paper-I, candidates will be shortlisted category-wise to appear in Paper-II, which is a descriptive paper testing translation and essay writing skills in both Hindi and English, carrying 200 marks. Marks scored in Paper-I will be normalized if the exam is held in multiple shifts. Tentative Answer Keys will be uploaded after the exam, and candidates can submit online representations within the given time on payment of ₹50 per question (non-refundable).

Paper Mode Subject Questions / Marks Duration
Paper-I (Objective) Computer Based Part-I: General Hindi
Part-II: General English		 100/100
100/100		 2 Hours (Sectional timer: 1 hr each part)
{2 hrs 40 min for scribe-eligible candidates}
Paper-II (Descriptive) Pen & Paper Translation (Hindi ↔ English) & Essay 200 Marks 2 Hours
{2 hrs 40 min for scribe-eligible candidates}

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 consists of two stages. In the first stage, Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) is used to shortlist candidates category-wise for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I are 30% for UR, 25% for OBC/EWS, and 20% for all other categories. In the second stage, Paper-II (Descriptive) is conducted for shortlisted candidates.

For the final merit list, 50% weightage is given to Paper-I scores and 100% weightage to Paper-II marks. Final selection and allocation of Ministry/Department/Organization is based on merit-cum-preference of posts/departments exercised by candidates through an Online Option Form. In case of a tie, it is resolved by total marks in Paper-II, then date of birth (older preferred), and finally alphabetical order of names. Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years and all posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL).

Stage Details
1. Paper-I (CBE) Objective type; used for shortlisting category-wise candidates for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks: UR 30%, OBC/EWS 25%, Others 20%
2. Paper-II (Descriptive) Translation passages (Hindi ↔ English) and Essay; 200 marks; qualifying based on Paper-I merit
3. Final Merit 50% weightage of Paper-I + 100% weightage of Paper-II marks
4. Post Preference & Allocation Online Option Form to be submitted before FRTA; merit-cum-preference based allocation
5. Document Verification Conducted by User Departments/Organizations after declaration of final result

Tie-Breaking Order

1st Higher total marks in Paper-II
2nd Date of Birth - older candidate preferred
3rd Alphabetical order of names of candidates

How to Apply for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026

The application process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is entirely online at https://ssc.gov.in. Candidates who have not yet completed their One-Time Registration (OTR) on the new SSC website must do so first, as the earlier OTR from the old website (ssc.nic.in) is not valid for the new portal. Aadhaar-based biometric authentication is available and recommended - candidates who opt for it will not face rejection on grounds of photograph or signature quality.

The application module is designed to capture a live photograph of the candidate through webcam or mobile device; pre-existing photographs must not be submitted. Candidates must also upload their scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB). Applications with blurred or miniature photographs or signatures will be summarily rejected unless Aadhaar authentication has been opted for. Only one online application per candidate is permitted during the normal application period.

  • Visit the official website https://ssc.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR).
  • Login using Registration Number and Password.
  • Click on "Apply" under "Combined Hindi Translators Examination, 2026" in the Live Exam tab.
  • Fill in educational details, additional information (ESM/age relaxation), and examination centre preferences (up to 3 centres).
  • Capture live photograph through webcam/mobile as per instructions (no cap, mask, or spectacles).
  • Upload scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB), dimensions ~6.0 cm (W) × 2.0 cm (H).
  • PwBD/PwD candidates must upload Disability Certificate as per Annexure-I/IA/X/XI, whichever is applicable.
  • Preview the application carefully, complete the declaration, and submit before 14.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card on or before 15.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Form

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 can do so by submitting their application form online only. The application process is entirely online, and candidates must ensure they complete all steps including OTR, form filling, photograph/signature upload, and fee payment before the respective closing dates.

The application form is accessible through the official SSC website after completing One-Time Registration. Candidates are strongly advised to fill the application carefully as only one application is accepted per candidate - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature. Details such as name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth must be filled exactly as they appear in the Matriculation Certificate. After final submission, modifications are only permitted during the correction window (19.05.2026 to 20.05.2026) on payment of correction charges.

Apply Online at: https://ssc.gov.in

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates applying for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 must read the official notification carefully in its entirety before filling and submitting the application form. The English version of the notice will prevail in case of any dispute. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute server load issues on the SSC website. All candidatures are provisional - the Commission does not undertake detailed scrutiny at the time of the written examination, and eligibility will be verified only at the Document Verification stage by the User Departments. Any suppression or misrepresentation of information in the application can lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including after selection. Canvassing in any form will result in immediate disqualification. The decision of the Commission in all matters including eligibility, selection, and allocation of posts is final and binding.

  • Read the official notice carefully before applying; English version prevails in case of dispute.
  • Only one online application is permitted per candidate; multiple applications will be rejected.
  • Name, DOB, father's name, and mother's name must match the Matriculation Certificate exactly.
  • Candidates must keep a printout of their application for at least 3 years for future reference.
  • Post preference must be submitted online before FRTA declaration; options once submitted are final.
  • All posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL) - candidates may be posted anywhere in India.
  • Regularly check https://ssc.gov.in for updates on exam dates, vacancies, admit cards, and results.

NMDC Junior Engineer Mining Recruitment 2026 Remuneration & Benefits

Selected candidates for the Junior Engineer (Mining) post will receive a consolidated pay of ₹60,000/- per month. Remuneration will be calculated based on actual attendance and prorated deductions will be made for absence.

In addition to the consolidated pay, selected candidates will be entitled to several benefits including Accidental Group Insurance coverage for accidents arising out of or during the course of employment, outpatient expenses for self-treatment of ₹35,000/- per annum, House Rent Allowance (HRA) as applicable, and TA/DA for official tours.

Candidates who are unable to produce the required original documents meeting the essential eligibility criteria will not be allowed to attend the assessment and will not be reimbursed Travelling Allowance.

The merit list will be drawn based on the candidates' performance in the Supervisory Skill Assessment. NMDC Management reserves the right to alter or fix the criteria for calling candidates for the assessment based on the number of applications received. The decision of NMDC Management will be final in all matters relating to the selection process and no interim correspondence will be entertained.

PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Online Written Test followed by a Personal Interview, or a Personal Interview only, depending upon the number of applications received against each post. The Bank may decide to follow either of two scenarios. Under Scenario 1 (Online Written Test + Interview):

The written test consists of Part I covering Reasoning (25 marks), English Language (25 marks), and Quantitative Aptitude (50 marks) - totalling 100 marks - and Part II covering Professional Knowledge (50 questions, 100 marks), with the entire test to be completed in 120 minutes.

For each wrong answer, one-fourth of the marks assigned will be deducted as penalty. Part II (Professional Knowledge) will be evaluated only for candidates who qualify in each paper of Part I. Candidates who qualify Part I will be shortlisted for interview based on marks in Part II. Personal Interview will carry 50 marks, and candidates must score minimum qualifying marks in the interview to be considered for final selection.

The final merit will be based on aggregate scores of Part II of the Online Written Test and the Interview. Under Scenario 2 (Shortlisting + Interview): Applications will be screened, eligible candidates will be called for a Personal Interview of 50 marks, and final selection will be based solely on interview scores.

Territorial Army Commission 2026 Salary / Pay Scale

Officers commissioned in the Territorial Army will receive pay and allowances at par with Regular Army Officers when embodied for training and military service as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) pay matrix. Commission is granted in the rank of Lieutenant with a pay level of 10 in the pay matrix. In addition to basic pay, officers receive Military Service Pay (MSP) of ₹15,500/- per month.

However, since Territorial Army is a part-time commitment with mandatory two months of training per year, pay and allowances are applicable only during the period of embodiment for training or military service. Serving in the Territorial Army does not guarantee pension, which is subject to embodied service as per organisational requirement. Promotions up to Lt Colonel are by time scale subject to fulfilling laid-down criteria, while promotion to Colonel and Brigadier is by selection.

How to Apply for Territorial Army Commission 2026

Candidates are required to apply online only by using the official website www.indianarmy.nic.in. No other mode is allowed for submission of application. Payment of the examination fee of ₹500/- must be made through the prescribed online modes only.

Territorial Army Commission 2026 Application Form

The online application window is open from 20 April 2026 (1000 Hours) to 19 May 2026 (2355 Hours) only. Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates applying for Territorial Army Commission 2026 must carefully read all instructions mentioned in the official notification before submitting their application. Territorial Army is a part-time commitment with mandatory two months of training per year and does not guarantee a full-time career or pension. Serving members of the Regular Army, Navy, Air Force, Police, GREF, Para Military, and like forces are not eligible to apply. Selection Process

The recruitment process will consist of Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Physical Standards Test (PST), Computer Based Test (CBT), Trade/Skill Test, Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (DME/RME).

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Qualifying in nature.
    • For Constable (Driver, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Gardner, Painter, Carpenter, Brass Band, Pipe Band, Cobbler, Tailor & Bugler): Male – 5 Kms race in 24 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 8.30 minutes.
    • For Constable (Cook/Water Carrier, Barber & Hair Dresser, Washer man & Washer women, Safai Karmachari): Male – 1.6 Kms in 10 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 12 minutes.
    • For Pioneer Wing (Mason / Electrician): Male – 1.6 Kms in 09 minutes.
    • Pregnant women candidates will be declared temporarily unfit.
  • Physical Standards Test (PST): Height, Chest (for males only) & Weight (proportionate to height & age).
    • Height: Male – 170 Cms (minimum); Female – 157 Cms (minimum). Relaxations applicable for certain categories (ST, NE States, Gorkhas, etc.).
    • Chest (Male only): Un-expanded – 80 Cms, Minimum expansion – 05 Cms. Relaxations applicable.
    • Candidates failing PST will be eliminated.
  • Computer Based Test (CBT): 100 marks (100 MCQs), duration 02 hours.
    • General Intelligence & Reasoning – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • General Knowledge & General Awareness – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Elementary Mathematics – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • English/Hindi – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
    • Qualifying marks: UR – 30%, EWS/OBC – 25%, SC/ST & others – 20%.
    • Marks will be normalized. Merit list prepared on CBT marks.
  • Trade/Skill Test: Qualifying in nature (50 marks, minimum 20 marks required). Practical assessment of the applied trade/post.
  • Document Verification (DV): Original documents (Matric certificate, Domicile/PRC, Trade certificates, Caste/EWS/ESM certificates, etc.) will be verified.
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): As per Uniform Guidelines issued by MHA. Temporary unfitness allowed only for pregnancy. Final selection subject to medical fitness.
  • Final merit list prepared on the basis of marks obtained in CBT (subject to qualifying all stages). Separate merit lists for male/female and each State/UT (All India basis for Pioneer posts).

Application Mode: Online only through CRPF website. No other mode will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official website www.rect.crpf.gov.in.
  2. Click on the link for “Recruitment for the post of Constable (Technical & Tradesmen and Pioneer) 2026”.
  3. Register by providing basic details and generate Provisional Registration Number & Password.
  4. Fill the online application form carefully (personal details, educational qualification, trade/post applied, State/UT of domicile, etc.).
  5. Upload scanned copies of recent colour passport size photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per specifications.
  6. Pay the application fee online (if applicable) through BHIM, UPI, Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card or CSC Wallet.
  7. Submit the application and take printout of the application form & e-receipt for future reference.
  8. Candidates should bring two coloured printouts of the Admit Card at every stage of examination.

RRB Group D Eligibility Criteria 2026 – Quick Overview

  • Minimum Education: 10th pass (Matriculation) from a recognized board, or ITI from NCVT/SCVT, or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in relevant trade.

  • Age Range: Generally 18–33 years (calculated as on the cutoff date mentioned in the notification, such as 01.01.2026).

RRB Group D Educational Qualification 2026

The minimum educational qualification for RRB Group D 2026 requires candidates to have:

  • Passed Class 10/Matriculation from a recognized board, or

  • ITI certificate from NCVT/SCVT in a relevant trade, or

  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT.

Equivalence like NIOS/open schooling is generally accepted if recognized and mentioned in the official notification—always verify the exact clause in the CEN PDF. Final-year or appearing candidates are typically not eligible; the qualification must be completed by the application closing date.

Common doubts:

  • Gap years or backlogs do not disqualify if the certificate is obtained.

  • Subject stream usually does not matter for non-technical posts.

  • Always cross-check with the official notification to avoid issues.

The general age limit for RRB Group D 2026 is 18 to 33 years, calculated as on the date specified in the notification (e.g., 01.01.2026). Candidates must fall within this range before applying.

RRB Group D Nationality Criteria 2026

Under RRB Group D nationality criteria, candidates must be:

  • A citizen of India, or

  • A subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or

  • A Tibetan refugee who came to India before January 1, 1962 (with intent to settle permanently), or

  • A person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, etc.) with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India.

Most applicants qualify as Indian citizens.

RRB Group D Physical Eligibility & PET 2026

The RRB Group D physical standards include two stages: PET (qualifying) and medical examination.

Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Requirements

PET is qualifying (pass/fail) and conducted for shortlisted CBT candidates. Typical requirements (as per notification; may vary slightly):

  • Male candidates: Running a specified distance in given time, lifting/carrying weight over distance.

  • Female candidates: Adjusted distance/weight parameters.

Only those passing PET proceed further.

RRB Group D Medical Standards 2026

The medical exam follows document verification and includes vision (distant/near), color vision, blood pressure, cardiac, hearing, and general fitness checks. Posts fall under A-2, B-1, C-1, etc., categories candidates must meet the standards for allotted posts.

Common disqualifying reasons include poor eyesight beyond limits, uncontrolled chronic conditions, or major disabilities incompatible with duties. Exact conditions are in the official rules.

Important Documents Required for RRB Group D Eligibility Verification

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate and mark sheet.

  • PwBD certificate (if claiming).

  • Ex-servicemen discharge certificate.

  • Photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, etc.).

  • Passport-size photographs (per specs).

Who Is Not Eligible for RRB Group D 2026?

  • Candidates below 18 or above 33 years (even after relaxation).

  • Those without required 10th/ITI/NAC by cutoff date.

  • Non-eligible nationality or missing certificates.

  • Failing PET or medical exam.

  • Incomplete, incorrect, or forged documents.

  • Debarred by RRB or with disqualifying background (if specified).

The RRB NTPC City Intimation Slip 2026 for Graduate Level posts under CEN 06/2025 (Non-Technical Popular Categories) is fully released and available for download as of March 18, 2026. The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) issued it in phases starting from March 7, 2026, with the final phases (including for exams up to March 27, 2026) activated by March 17, 2026. All candidates whose CBT-1 is scheduled from March 16 to March 27, 2026, can now access their slip.

FOLLOW US

This slip provides advance information on your allotted exam city, exam date, shift timing, reporting/gate closing times, and basic instructions to help plan travel and logistics. It is not the admit card (e-Call Letter/Hall Ticket), which has been releasing phased (e.g., March 12 for March 16 exam, March 13 for March 17, up to ~4 days before your date). The full exam center address, roll number, photo, signature, and detailed guidelines are only on the admit card.

Key Highlights:

  • Release Status: Fully Released (phased from March 7 to March 17, 2026; now available for all dates March 16–27, 2026)
  • Exam Dates (CBT-1): March 16, 17, 18, 19, 22, 23, 24, 25, and 27, 2026 (9 days total; 3 shifts daily)
  • Shifts (Typical Timings):
    • Shift 1: Reporting ~7:30 AM, Gate closes ~8:30 AM, Exam 9:00 AM–10:30 AM
    • Shift 2: Reporting ~11:15 AM, Gate closes ~12:15 PM, Exam 12:45 PM–2:15 PM
    • Shift 3: Reporting ~3:00 PM, Gate closes ~4:00 PM, Exam 4:30 PM–6:00 PM
  • Exam Mode: Computer Based Test (Online CBT); 90 minutes duration; 1/3 negative marking for wrong answers
  • Total Vacancies: 5,810 Graduate Level Posts (e.g., Station Master, Goods Train Manager, Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor, Senior Clerk cum Typist, Junior Account Assistant cum Typist)
  • Official Portal: Centralized download at rrb.digialm.com; access via regional RRB websites (e.g., rrbcdg.gov.in for Chandigarh zone)

  1. Visit your regional RRB website (find your zone via rrbcdg.gov.in or official list).

Use this formula to estimate your score (based on standard SSC scheme):

About the Role:

Weâre looking for a Social Media Growth Lead to build, engage, grow, and retain audiences of senior decision-makers on social platforms and convert them into subscribers and loyal members of our community.

This role is responsible for turning our content, audio, events, and insights into high-performing, platform-native formats that drive visibility, repeat engagement, and measurable audience growth.

You will own how our brands show up across social channels by translating our core ideas into content senior leaders watch, engage with, return to, and build habits around. You will connect social performance directly to subscriber growth by building repeatable systems for distribution, engagement, conversion, and retention.

Your work will expand our reach, deepen engagement, increase retention, and consistently drive new audience members into our owned channels.

\n


Who You Are:
  • You understand how content performs on social platforms and what makes senior decision-makers stop, watch, engage, return, and build ongoing consumption habits.
  • You are comfortable working across video, audio, written, and event-driven content and know how to translate ideas into formats that fit each platform.
  • You think in terms of distribution, engagement, growth, and retention, with a focus on reaching and sustaining a high-value audience of senior leaders.
  • You are data-informed and action-oriented. You track performance closely, understand what is working, and adjust quickly.
  • You know how to take a piece of content or moment and extend its reach through packaging, timing, and amplification.


What Youâll Be Doing:
1. Translate and distribute content into social formats: You will extend the reach of our content and thought leadership across social platforms.
  • Capture and repurpose video, written, audio, and event content
  • Create short-form, platform-native content across channels
  • Identify and extract key moments from editorial, audio, and events
  • Extract and adapt key moments from audio content into short-form formats
  • Translate ideas into formats that are engaging, shareable, and repeatable
  • Experiment with emerging formats and platform features
Your goal is to make content visible, relevant, and consistently consumed by senior decision-makers across social platforms.
 
2. Execute social growth campaigns across organic, paid, and partner channels: You will plan and launch campaigns that amplify key content and drive audience growth.
  • Launch campaigns tied to content, events, and thought leadership
  • Use organic distribution, paid amplification, and partnerships to extend reach
  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns to drive reach, engagement, and subscriber growth
  • Build and manage creator and expert partnerships
  • Execute distribution partnerships across platforms
  • Build and manage direct relationships with platform partners such as LinkedIn and YouTube to unlock distribution opportunities, features, and insights
  • Identify and leverage platform opportunities to increase visibility
Your goal is to consistently expand reach, increase engagement, and bring new audience members into our ecosystem.

3. Optimize performance and build repeat engagement and retention: You will own how social performance improves over time.
  • Track performance across content, campaigns, and paid channels
  • Analyze engagement, reach, repeat interaction, and retention data
  • Optimize formats, timing, targeting, and distribution strategies
  • Continuously test and refine content and campaign approaches
  • Build repeatable formats and campaigns that drive consistent engagement and return behavior
Your goal is to turn one-time interactions into repeat behaviors and sustained audience engagement.
 
4. Drive subscriber growth and community development from social channels: You will connect social activity directly to audience growth.
  • Develop and execute strategies that convert social audiences into subscribers
  • Optimize social-to-subscriber conversion pathways
  • Ensure social content consistently drives traffic to owned channels
  • Track and improve conversion performance across platforms
  • Build repeatable systems that turn engagement into measurable subscriber growth
Your goal is to ensure social media is a reliable and growing source of new subscribers and engaged community members.
 
5. Measure performance and optimize for audience growth and retention: You will own how social performance is measured and improved, with a clear focus on growth and retention.
  • Define how success is measured across social content and campaigns
  • Track and analyze performance across organic, paid, and partner channels
  • Identify what is driving engagement, reach, subscriber growth, and retention
  • Make clear adjustments to improve performance over time
  • Ensure social activity is tied to measurable audience growth and retention outcomes
Your work should lead to continuous improvement in engagement, reach, audience growth, and retention.


How Your Success Will Be Measured:
  • Growth in subscribers and engaged community members from social channels
  • Growth in engaged audience across social platforms
  • Increased return engagement and retention from audiences acquired from social
  • Strong performance across video views, engagement rates, campaigns, and paid performance
  • Consistent execution of high-performing social content and campaigns


Your Skillset Includes:
  • Experience producing short-form, platform-native video content and ideas into engaging social formats
  • Experience running and optimizing organic and paid social campaigns, including managing budgets and performance
  • Experience tracking and analyzing performance across social channels
  • Ability to optimize content and campaigns based on data
  • Experience working with partners, creators, or collaborators
  • Highly organized content planner, comfortable building and leveraging social calendars and plans.
  • Strong judgment in content selection, timing, and distribution


Nice to Haves:
  • Experience distributing thought leadership or editorial content at a B2B / media brand
  • Experience working with audio content and translating it into social formats
  • Existing relationships with LinkedIn and/or YouTube platform partner teams
  • Background capturing and repurposing content from our contributors, events and other sources
  • Experimentation / A/B testing discipline on content formats and paid creative
  • On-camera comfort and experience coaching internal experts to perform on video
